# PPPlayer

> A free, open-source music player. No account. No subscription. Just play.

PPPlayer is a cross-platform music player app available on macOS, Android (APK), iOS (TestFlight), and Windows. It lets users discover music, stream tracks, and explore artists — without requiring an account or subscription. The app is fully open-source under a permissive license and welcomes contributions.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://ppplayer.com
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/ppplayermusic/app
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/ppplayermusic
- **License**: MIT — https://github.com/ppplayermusic/ppplayer/blob/main/LICENSE
- **Current version**: 1.1.2
- **Built with**: Flutter (Dart), targeting macOS, Android, iOS, Windows

- **macOS**: https://github.com/ppplayermusic/app/releases/latest/download/PPPlayer-macOS.dmg
- **Android (APK)**: https://github.com/ppplayermusic/app/releases/latest/download/PPPlayer-Android.apk
- **iOS**: Available via TestFlight (see download page)
- **Windows**: Available via GitHub Releases (see download page)

## Features

- Stream and discover music without an account
- YouTube-powered playback via an embedded iframe bridge
- Artist radio and discovery mode
- Queue management and playlist support
- Background audio playback on all platforms
- Open-source — inspect, fork, and contribute freely

## Contributing

- **Issues & Bug Reports**: https://github.com/ppplayermusic/app/issues

## Localization

The website and app support 13 languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, Turkish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and Chinese (Simplified).
